text:
Omar: Hey everyone, day 2 question pile: where do I post for hardware pickup scheduling (I prefer afternoon), who do I ping to be assigned an onboarding buddy, how do I set the onboarding bot to my timezone so it doesn't DM me at 3am, and any channel rules I should know (gifs, threads, urgent pings)? Trying to not be that new person who clogs channels :sweat_smile:
IT Team: For hardware pickup -> #people-ops with preferred window (e.g., "afternoons after 1pm") and your desk/office. If you need shipping add address. For imaging issues -> #eng-infra and include serial & current image. If it's urgent DM IT Team.
Zoe (People Ops): Buddy assignments come from People Ops. Post "buddy request" in #new-hires and we'll pair you within 48h. For hardware pickup put: full name, office, preferred time window.
Omar: Cool. Onboarding bot keeps pinging overnight. How to change timezone?
OnboardBot: Commands to manage timing and topics:
`/onboard timezone Europe/London` -> sets your timezone for scheduled DMs
`/onboard quiet 22:00-07:00` -> silence DMs during that window
`/onboard topics infra,docs,policies` -> only receive topics you care about
`/onboard pause 14d` -> pause for 14 days
`/onboard stop` -> unsubscribe
Example quick set:
```
/onboard timezone America/Los_Angeles
/onboard quiet 23:00-08:00
/onboard topics access,getting-started
```
Note: click Manage in the initial welcome DM for a GUI too.
MentorBot: For mentorship pairing use `/mentor pair` in #new-hires-mentors or DM me to request specific skill tags (e.g., infra, model-serving).
Grace (DevEx): Channels: use your team channel for codebase questions first. Use threads for follow-ups so search stays clean. For cross-team infra or org-level access -> #eng-infra or #help. If you start in the team channel and infra needs to act, paste the Access Form ticket link in-thread so infra can pick it up.
Luca: Etiquette quick hits: avoid @here/@channel unless outage/office-wide. Use reactions for quick ack (:thumbsup: / :eyes:). Keep one question per thread. For long logs use a Gist/Drive link and a 1-line summary. Sensitive or security stuff -> DM security lead and post a short incident note to #eng-security (no secrets in channel).
Omar: Nice. Any soft rules about gifs and memes? Some teams love them.
Zoe (People Ops): #random is the place for memes/gifs. Be mindful in professional channels (no gifs in #eng-security, #people-ops, #finance). If unsure, use #random or DM.
IT Team: Scheduling pickup example to post in #people-ops:
"Omar - badge + laptop pickup, SF office, prefer afternoons 13:00-16:00, contact ext 1234"
That helps us slot you.
Omar: Where do I post my intro? Short or long?
Grace (DevEx): Intro format that people like: one-line role, two-sentence background, timezone, one thing you're excited to work on. Post in #introductions and drop a :wave: in your team channel. Example:
"Omar — Backend Engineer. Previously at X building infra for ML. Based in PST. Excited about inference runtime perf."
Keep it short so people actually read it.
OnboardBot: Reminder: you can also opt into Office Hours -> `/onboard office-hours` to get a weekly slot with DevEx/IT for live help in #office-hours.
Omar: Very helpful, will do the timezone + quiet window and post the hardware pickup. Thanks all :pray:
Luca: Quick add: if you need a quick eyes-on today, ping a person directly and prepend URGENT in the first line instead of using @channel. Saves noise and gets faster responses.
Omar: Got it. Thanks again everyone :wave:
